unmet_needs: SpecTrunk branches accept no label and no style, so an uncertain branch cannot be dashed inside a trunk; the only honest bus candidate here (.60-.62 marked free?) would have lost its qualifier, and the renderer refused both placements anyway ('no obstacle-safe route for nic -> s2, nic -> spare').
Group colour has no per-group override: families follow group order of first appearance, so two views with different group sets cannot keep every concept on one hue.
